title: Agent-Activity Map State IR
description: Intermediate representation of live agent activity across the work hierarchy (roadmap -> change -> work package -> files). Produced by a coordinator projection endpoint and consumed by map renderers, snapshot writers, and delta tooling. Draft contract for the codeviz roadmap items map-state-ir and agent-activity-map-lens. Invariant: every node and edge carries provenance naming the store it was read from - renderers MUST NOT display an edge this document cannot cite.

snapshot_id.description: Unique id for this document. Live projections use an opaque per-response id; frozen snapshots use the run-id of the event artifact that embeds them.

base_snapshot_id.description: Optional id of an earlier snapshot this one is intended to be diffed against (delta chains at sync points / checkpoints).

git_sha.description: Repo head at generation time, when the producer runs inside a checkout.

snapshot_kind.description: live = transient coordinator projection; checkpoint = persisted at a sync point or roadmap checkpoint; frozen-export = self-contained shareable export.

producer.description: Component that emitted the document, e.g. coordination_api:/map/state.

repo_ids.description: Repos covered by this snapshot; single-entry until multi-repo federation lands.

layout.description: Optional stable-layout hints. Zones come from parallel_zones.json so the map keeps the same geography across sessions; positions persist a renderer's seeded layout.

members.description: Node ids anchored inside this zone.

positions.description: Map of node id to persisted canvas position.

provenance.description: Where this element was read from. At least one entry is mandatory; renderers surface these as clickable receipts.

store.description: Authoritative store the fact was read from. 'derived' marks values computed from other entries in the same list (e.g. agent activity), which MUST also be present.

evidence.description: Pointer into the store: a row id, audit event id, registry key, file path plus glob, or derivation rule name. Human-followable.

confidence.description: Optional; omit for facts read verbatim from an authoritative store.

id.description: Namespaced stable id. Conventions: roadmap:<roadmap_id>, item:<roadmap_id>/<item_id>, change:<change_id>, wp:<change_id>/<package_id>, agent:<canonical_agent_id>, worktree:<branch>, path:<repo-relative-path-or-lock-key>, sync:<sync_point_id>.

status.description: Kind-specific lifecycle status, copied verbatim from the owning store (roadmap.yaml item status, work_queue status, sync-point state). Agent liveness lives in activity, not here.

claimed_by.description: work_package only: node id of the claiming agent, mirrored by a claimed_by edge.

scope.description: work_package only: declared file intent from work-packages.yaml, rendered as the package's territory.

identities.description: agent only: reconciliation of the three agent-id forms in use today. The node id uses the canonical form; these record the aliases it was joined from.

vendor.description: Vendor suffix parsed from the <package>--<vendor> convention.

activity.description: agent only: derived activity state. working = fresh heartbeat + active claim; waiting = latest status report has needs_human=true or a pending approval; idle = fresh heartbeat, no claim; stale = heartbeat older than the staleness threshold; disconnected = session ended or cleaned up. The derivation rule MUST appear as a 'derived' provenance entry.

raw_status.description: agent only: verbatim agent_sessions.status the activity was derived from.

path_namespace.description: path only: 'file' for real repo paths; otherwise the logical lock-key namespace sharing the file_locks.file_path column.

metadata.description: Producer extension point; renderers MUST NOT require it.

kind.description: contains: hierarchy (roadmap>item, item>change, change>wp). depends_on: DAG edges from roadmap.yaml / work-packages.yaml. claimed_by: wp>agent from work_queue.claimed_by. working_in: agent>worktree from the registry. locks_path: agent>path from file_locks. scoped_to: wp>path declared intent from scope globs. touched: agent>path observed activity from scope_checker diffs or audit events - the intent-vs-reality counterpart of scoped_to. blocked_by: item/wp>item/wp from blocked state.

expires_at.description: locks_path only: file_locks.expires_at, so renderers can fade expiring locks.

out_of_scope.description: touched only: true when the touch falls outside the owning package's write_allow - the scope-violation signal.

metadata.description: Producer extension point; renderers MUST NOT require it.
